lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 12 visible white vertical segments. Spacing is irregular, with wider intervals (estimated 15-20% of torso length) in the mid-section and tighter clustering in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines are discontinuous, transitioning from solid segments at the dorsal ridge into series of discrete spots on the mid-to-lower flank.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6-7 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-thigh align to form a semi-vertical geometric line descending toward the stifle.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a lyrate trajectory, initiating with a posterior curve from the frontal bone and spiraling into a dorsal-vertical orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tip occupies approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the primary horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the eyes and two high-contrast white spots on the lateral facial plane; prominent shaggy fringe extending along the ventral neck and abdominal midline.
